comment: A Tourist with 10 hit points quaffs a wished-for potion of polymorph in debug mode. polyself.c polyself() fails the rn2(20) > ACURR(A_CON) system-shock test, and the rnd(30) damage from losehp() reaches end.c done(); after y at Die?, C's done() never returns, so exercise(A_CON, FALSE) draws no random number. Answering q at the disclosure prompt and n at Save bones? ends the game.
